newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish c.bank, finmin meet to discuss rates, budget.
newsitem.headline: Polish c.bank, finmin meet to discuss rates, budget.

text.p: Poland's central bank chief and finance minister met on Wednesday met to discuss the situation on the money market and trends in the economy, the finance ministry's press office said.

"National Bank of Poland President Hanna Gronkiewicz-Waltz informed the finance minister about the NBP's various actions, including the bank's intention to raise interest rates," it said in a statement.
"Finance Minister Marek Belka, on the other hand, talked about the budget situation and the financing of spending on the reconstruction of areas affected by the floods," it said.

For the last three weeks southern and western Poland has been hard hit by the worst floods in centuries which have killed 54, forced tens of thousands out of their homes, inundated a total of more than 6,000 sq km and caused damage running into billions of dollars.
The finance ministry has so far borrowed one billion zlotys from the central bank for the flood relief effort out of a 2.5 billion zloty special credit line imposed on the bank by parliament.
